newsitem.title: USA: First Enterprise in $15 mln financing agreement.
newsitem.headline: First Enterprise in $15 mln financing agreement.

text.p: First Enterprise Financial Group Inc said Tuesday it has entered into a $15 million purchase facility with BancOne Capital Partners V Ltd, an affiliate of Banc One Corp.

"We now have greater flexibility and liquidity with the addition of this commitment to our existing $85 million bank based credit facility," Michael Harrington, chief executive officer of First Enterprise, a used automobile loan maker, said in a news release.
The agreement expires February 20 and has an interest rate that runs at a premium to the 30-day commercial paper rate, the company said.
First Enterprise shares rose 3/8 to 7-3/4 Tuesday.
